title: Orak: A Foundational Benchmark for Training and Evaluating LLM Agents on Diverse Video Games
claim: A unified benchmark connects diverse environments and LLM agents through a standard interface to support multiple evaluation and training studies.
layout: 3 zones, left-to-right: games and agent, title, four result panels
description: A wide, three-part figure. On the left, a green box shows 12 video game screenshots in a 2x6 grid, labeled by genre (Action, Adventure, RPG, Simulation, Strategy, Puzzle). Below it, a blue LLM Agent box holds LLM logos (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama) plus dashed Tools and Prompts boxes. An MCP interface bar connects the agent to an Evaluator box, which lists configs (game, LLM, agent strategy) and returns a score. In the center, a large 'Orak' title with the subtitle 'A benchmark toward gaming LLM agent', a big arrow, and a cartoon brain mascot holding a game controller. On the right, a 2x2 grid of black-bordered panels shows a Gameplay Leaderboard table, an LLM Battle Arena Elo table, an Agent Study table, and a Fine-tuning Study bar chart. Each panel has a small icon.
caption: Overview of \benchname{}, a benchmark designed to train and evaluate LLM agents across 12 video games across genres. Using MCP as a plug-and-play interface, it ensures systematic assessment, supporting gameplay leaderboards, battle arenas, and studies on agentic modules and fine-tuning.
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are reshaping the game industry, by enabling more intelligent and human-preferable characters. Yet, current game benchmarks fall short of practical needs: they lack evaluations of diverse LLM capabilities across various game genres, studies of agentic modules crucial for complex gameplay, and fine-tuning datasets to adapt pre-trained LLMs into gaming agents. To fill these gaps, we present Orak, a benchmark for training and evaluating LLM agents across 12 popular video games spanning all major genres. Using a plug-and-play interface built on Model Context Protocol (MCP), Orak supports systematic and reproducible studies of agentic modules in varied game scenarios. We further release a fine-tuning dataset of expert LLM gameplay trajectories covering multiple genres, turning general LLMs into effective game agents. Orak offers a united evaluation framework, including game leaderboards, LLM battle arenas, and \fix{ablation studies} of input modality, agentic strategies, and fine-tuning effects, establishing a foundation towards versatile gaming agents. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/krafton-ai/Orak and https://huggingface.co/datasets/KRAFTON/Orak.
